fragments.text: יִזְכּוֹר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ בְּזִכְרוֹן טוֹב מֶלֶךְ:
כָּלָה אַל תַּעַשׂ לִשְׁאֵרִית בְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ.
נָא נְצוֹר חֶסֶד לְנִינֵי שָׁלְחוּ לוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֵֽילֵי מֶלֶךְ.
סְכוֹת בָּאֵי בְתַחַן לְמַר בָּכוּ אֶרְאֶלֵּי מֶלֶךְ.
עֱנוּתָם בַּל תְּבֶז לְלָן בַּמָּקוֹם עָלוּ וְיָרְדוּ בוֹ מַלְאֲכֵי מֶלֶךְ:
פְּדֵם הַיּוֹם מִדִּין גָּמוּר מִלְּחַיְּבֵם מֶלֶךְ.
תֵּפֶן בְּתוֹמְכֵי בָרוּךְ וּנְבָרֶכְךָ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים וָמֶלֶךְ:

He extends His glory this day in mercy, the King, He who tests all thoughts of small and great, the King, in majesty and might does the King gird Himself, heaven and earth quake from fear of the King.

He who has formed together their heart, will show grace, the King. He who knows all their deeds, will justify, the King. It is a memorial, a day of homage through the Shofar sound, a law for Israel, so that the King may acquit them. Food does He give to those who fear Him, He who appoints every king, eternally does He remember His covenant in kindly memory, the King.
Let not destruction overtake the remnant of the King’s sons (Israel), Therefore, our King, do we come before Thee. O King, yesterday did we approach Thee already to implore

Mayest Thou preserve grace towards the offspring of him to whom three of the King’s angels were sent (Abraham). Take heed of those who approach with prayer for the sake of him whom the King’s Erelim did bitterly bewail (Isaac at the sacrifice). Reject not their humility for the sake of him who lodged the night at the place where the King’s angels ascended and descended (Jacob).
Redeem them this day in judgment, do not utterly condemn them, O King. Acquit them in mercy, remember them kindly, O King.
Heed the sound of the blast of those who blow the Shofar before Thee this day
(heed the memory of the Shofar blast of those who commemorate before Thee this day)
Arouse compassion towards those who hope for Thee, O King.
Turn towards the supplication of the people who seek Thee, O King, heed those who hold firmly to the blessing of Thy Name, that we may bless Thee, O living God and King.

fragments.text: הַכֹּל יוֹדוּךָ וְהַכֹּל יְשַׁבְּחוּךָ. וְהַכֹּל יֹאמְרוּ אֵין קָדוֹשׁ כַּייָ: הַכֹּל יְרוֹמְמוּךָ סֶּֽלָה יוֹצֵר הַכֹּל. הָאֵל הַפּוֹתֵֽחַ בְּכָל־יוֹם דַּלְתוֹת שַׁעֲרֵי מִזְרָח: וּבוֹקֵֽעַ חַלּוֹנֵי רָקִֽיעַ. מוֹצִיא חַמָּה מִמְּקוֹמָהּ וּלְבָנָה מִמְּכוֹן שִׁבְתָּהּ: וּמֵאִיר לְעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ וּלְיוֹשְׁבָיו. שֶׁבָּרָא בְּמִדַּת רַחֲמִים: הַמֵּאִיר לָאָרֶץ וְלַדָּרִים עָלֶֽיהָ בְּרַחֲמִים. וּבְטוּבוֹ מְחַדֵּשׁ בְּכָל־יוֹם תָּמִיד מַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית: הַמֶּֽלֶךְ הַמְרוֹמָם לְבַדּוֹ מֵאָז. הַמְשֻׁבָּח וְהַמְפֹאָר וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא מִימוֹת עוֹלָם: אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים רַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ. אֲדוֹן עֻזֵּֽנוּ צוּר מִשְׂגַּבֵּֽנוּ. מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ מִשְׂגָּב בַּעֲדֵֽנוּ: אֵין כְּעֶרְכֶּךָ וְאֵין זוּלָתֶךָ. אֶפֶס בִּלְתֶּךָ וּמִי דוֹמֶה־לָּךְ: אֵין כְּעֶרְכֶּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה. וְאֵין זוּלָתְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא: אֶפֶס בִּלְתְּךָ גּוֹאֲלֵֽנוּ לִימוֹת הַמָּשִֽׁיחַ. וְאֵין דּוֹמֶה־לְךָ מוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ לִתְחִיַּת הַמֵּתִים:

All thank Thee, all praise Thee, all say: None is holy like the Lord. All exalt Thee, Selah, Creator of all, God who opens daily the portals of the Eastern gates and throws open windows of the firmament, brings forth the sun from its place and the moon from the site of its dwelling. He illuminates the whole world and its inhabitants whom He created through the attribute of mercy. He illuminates the earth and those who dwell on it with mercy, and in His goodness renews daily and constantly the work of creation. O King, who alone is exalted from of old, extolled and praised and glorified since days of antiquity. O God of eternity, in Thy great mercy have mercy upon us, Lord of our might, Rock of our fortress, shield of our salvation, a fortress around us. None can be compared with Thee, there is none except Thee, none beside Thee, and who resembles Thee? None can be compared with Thee, O Lord our God, in this world and there is none except Thee, our King, in the life of the future world. There will be nought besides Thee, our Redeemer, in the days of the anointed one and none resembles Thee, our Helper, at the revival of the dead.
